result.title: Words Speak Louder? Exploring the Language Shortcut of LLM-Driven Incomplete Multimodal Learning
result.comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://peacelwh.github.io/CoVeR/
result.summary: Is a face or a voice still heard once the words are known? Incomplete multimodal learning increasingly uses large language models (LLMs) as fusion engines: modality features enter as token blocks and missing modalities become placeholders. We find that LLM-driven fusion can override non-verbal evidence it can read. Contrasting its full-input prediction with counterfactual views, the same model shown one modality or no content, we identify language shortcuts. We build MR-Bench: MR-Bench-A types every test sample of four sentiment benchmarks; MR-Bench-H contains 900 human-validated clips (620 language-shortcut, LS; 280 non-verbal-shortcut, NS) from seven sources, and every model is scored on all of them. Zero-shot MLLMs solve at most 32.7% of the LS clips; adding the transcript to the muted video lowers vision-language accuracy by 46.1-53.1 points. Yet inverting a text-only model's answers solves 94.4%, so LS accuracy alone cannot establish use of non-verbal evidence. Inside the fusion LLM, fused states align increasingly with the text view late in the decoder. Counterfactual-View Reliability learning (CoVeR) trains views as unimodal judges and withholds fused supervision where they disagree. It achieves state-of-the-art results on five benchmarks without extra inference cost in accuracy mode. On MR-Bench-H, it reaches 61.7% LS and 93.6% NS accuracy; robust mode raises LS accuracy to 63.0% while lowering NS accuracy to 84.8%. Among LS clips solved without text, adding text causes errors on 30.1% with CoVeR versus 32.2% with LLM-Fusion. Project page: https://peacelwh.github.io/CoVeR/.

AI.brief_summary: 论文发现以 LLM 作融合引擎的不完整多模态学习存在「语言捷径」：文本证据会压制模型本可读到的非语言证据，作者据此构建 MR-Bench（含 900 条人工校验片段）诊断该现象，并提出 CoVeR——把各模态视图训练成单模态评判者、在视图分歧处撤除融合监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「融合状态在解码后期逐渐向文本视图对齐」的状态分析与反事实视图监督，直接对应视觉旁路、信息坍缩及答案是否真正使用非语言内容的问题，可为 latent 证据留存与监督分配设计提供核查线索。
